title: Matrix
description: The generic shape of the matrix file: entries by id, and relationships, each stored once for each side that states it. Every entry and every relationship carries side, which shows which of the two sides the fact came from. What kinds of entry and relationship exist, and the attributes each kind carries beside the members stated here, is declared in matrix-kinds.json. matrix_contract.py is generated from both files; scripts/portfolio/matrixstore.py is the only reader and writer of a matrix file.

relationships.description: Each relationship once for each side that states it, sorted by from, kind, to, the values of the kind's key attributes, and side.

entryId.description: An entry id: the entry's kind, a colon, and the rest of the id.

kindName.description: The name of an entry kind or a relationship kind; matrix-kinds.json declares which exist.

side.description: Which side a fact came from. architecture: beads, a PRD or an arc42 document states it, or the architect designed it; this side is the authority. repository: it was read from what is in a repository today; it is a hint.

Approved.description: The approved flag, a dirty bit: it names its owner, the Epic whose elaboration reviewed and approved this entry or relationship (first come, first elaborated), and for which the matrix and arc42 are filled out or corrected. Absent means no Epic's elaboration has approved it yet; nothing seeded is approved, the effective arc42 baseline included (effective-architecture skill, Lifecycle, the baseline and iteration). Another Epic's approval never replaces it. Any change that affects the entry or relationship itself clears it on that item alone, independently of the verified flag, until an Epic that reaches it is approved again and becomes its owner.

epic.description: The beads id of its owner, the Epic whose approval set it.

Verified.description: The verified flag, a dirty bit: this entry or relationship was built and tested, the CI checks and the test that its CDK deployment works included (the deployment need not remain). Set by the build pipeline on what one Story built when its test passes, before and apart from any merge; it belongs to the item, valid for every Epic that relates to it. Absent means not verified; nothing seeded is verified. A change to what the item must be built as clears it on that item alone, independently of the approved flag, until the next build and test of the item sets it again.

commit.description: The commit of the Story's branch whose test passed.

Entry.description: One entry. Every other member is an attribute its kind declares.

aliases.description: Other names the entry is known by.

purpose.description: One or two sentences that identify the entry.

Relationship.description: One relationship as one side states it. Every other member is an attribute its kind declares.
